verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a no-code, dashboard-created shareable payment link. The closest items are adjacent: prebuilt eCommerce-provider integrations that connect "in a few clicks" (third-party platforms, not payment links), and developer building blocks like the Checkout service, Invoices API and Web Payments SDK, which require code and earn no credit here. The axis clearly applies to a payments product, so the absence of evidence is "none" rather than "na".
